title: PPI v1 shared definitions
description: Building blocks shared by every PPI v1 schema. The $id is an identifier, not a location: nothing is served from spec.ppi.example (a reserved, non-resolvable domain).

ExternalRef.description: The host's own identifier for a record, an attachment or a party. Opaque to the provider and stable for the life of the object.

Version.description: Opaque host version of an object. It changes whenever the object changes; the same version always means the same content.

LevelCode.description: A sensitivity level code from the ordered list the host declares in its connection.

VocabularyCode.description: A code from one of the vocabularies the host declares in its connection (for example its document types or its organisational units).

SubjectRef.description: Pseudonymous reference to a host user. The host can map it back; the provider cannot. Recorded by the provider in its audit trail.

Span.description: Half-open range [start, end) of Unicode code point offsets into the provider's canonical text of the cited unit (the page when `page` is set, otherwise the whole unit). `end` is greater than `start`.

Identifier.description: An identifier of a party under a named scheme (for example a national ID type or a tax number). Schemes are host data, not protocol vocabulary.

Party.description: A person or organisation that appears on a record.
